title: Seven values of the X5 deviation have no source: the claim deadline, the Legal handler route, the case contract and its two event families, the platform outbox, the legal counsel's right, the requirement identifier and the sign-off
source: Template and Rules v1 sections R5.4, R5.5, R5.7 and R7.3; the metadata rows of RWB-S8-E7005-APP (Depends on (build) RWB-S8-E7005-CON, RWB-PLT-E1027-CON, RWB-PLT-N001-CON; Contract, Integration and External dependencies None) and of RWB-S8-E7005-CON (all None); Recovery Workbench FSD S8 Deviation handling v3 A2.2.2, A2.14.2 and A2.14.3.3; Recovery Workbench TSD S8 Deviation handling v2 T3.1, T3.2, T4, T5.3, T6.1 and appendix T-A.1; Recovery Workbench Event and Messaging Design v4 (EV-06 and EV-07 with their three fields each); Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slide 13 (connection matrix, row S8 Deviation) and slide 19; 04 User stories/Recovery Workbench User Stories Epics 3 to 8 v3.md heading RWB-E7-005
section: APP s2 Business rationale; s3 Preconditions; s8 Business rules; s9 State transitions; s10 Authority; s11 Data; s12.2 REST operations consumed; s12.3 Events published; s12.4 Events consumed; s12.9 Call-type summary; s13 Solution plan; s18 Traceability
description: The X5 slice of the deviation needs seven things that no source in the fill order of Template and Rules section R7.3 gives and that no metadata row carries. (1) The claim deadline behind R-DEV-05's action "file with the official receiver or the LED before the deadline": the Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 row gives the service level as "deadline driven" and no number, and neither the FSD nor the TSD gives one. (2) The Legal handler route of R-DEV-05: the rule names "Legal" as the owner and the deviation stores handler_user_id, but no source gives the role code, the queue or the mapping from deviation code to handler that the route reads. (3) The case contract of rwb-case that reads the case state, pauses and resumes the stage clock and accepts the route fact: Architecture v5 slide 13 gives rwb-deviation the letter E to rwb-case (it listens) and no REST letter, so the pause is announced and the case is not called, and no source names the operation or the event that carries the pause, the resume and the re-open at D6. (4) The platform outbox behind the two published events: DP-09 is not in this key's pattern set (DP03, DP13, DP19), so H RWB-PLT-TE006-CON is absent from the metadata while EV-06 and EV-07 are published by this service in the event catalogue. (5) The right of the legal counsel: FSD S8 A2.14.3.3 names Legal counsel as the primary actor of X5, while TSD S8 T6.1 gives RW-LEGAL the right R only on the case record and PF-LEGAL nothing, and the legacy permission block gives Case record U to eleven roles. (6) The requirement identifier: the legacy master, the Epics 3 to 8 specification and TSD S8 T8 carry no REQ identifier for the feature, so both slices trace to FEAT-DVF-05 only. (7) The approval: the FSD and the TSD are In review with an empty sign-off table and no human approval step exists in D-RCV-60, so both slices carry Status Draft (realignment v1). The metadata rows are kept exactly as the plan gives them, nothing is invented, and the seven are recorded once here with one assumption each.
evidence: Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 row R-DEV-05: service level "deadline driven" with no value, owner "Legal", channel "LIT, Workbench"; FSD S8 v3 A2.14.3.3 lists Legal counsel as Primary and Enforcement owner as Also uses; TSD S8 v2 T6.1 gives RW-LEGAL the right R and no right C, U or A on the case record; the legacy permission block of RWB-E7-005 gives Case record U to RW-CASEOWN, RW-RESTRUCT, RW-SPECIAL, RW-COMPLAIN, RW-FRAUD, RW-LITOFF, RW-ENFORCE, RW-SALEOFF and four more; Architecture v5 slide 13 row S8 Deviation carries E under P3, R and E under P1 and T and E under P10 only; Event and Messaging Design v4 rows EV-06 and EV-07 name three payload fields each and no envelope; TSD S8 v2 T5.3 declares DeviationRaised and DeviationCleared as Published; the metadata rows of both slices carry Contract, Integration and External dependencies None; TSD S8 v2 and FSD S8 v3 carry Status In review and an empty sign-off table.
area: Reference data and contracts, S8 rwb-deviation with P3 rwb-case, P4 rwb-access and the platform event library
proposed: Keep both metadata rows as the plan gives them; carry the claim deadline, the SLA and the Legal route as versioned reference rows with the placeholder; build against the case fake on Day 1; declare Case record U on both operations and leave the widening of RW-LEGAL to rwb-access; publish the two catalogue events through the platform outbox and let step D1 decide whether RWB-PLT-TE006-CON and a rwb-case contract story become C or H dependencies of this key; trace both slices to FEAT-DVF-05 until the Epic 3 to 8 PRD adds the identifiers.

title: Five shapes of the deviation contract have no source: the index set, the case announcement operation name, the outcome-to-state mapping, the outbox behind the two events and the unnamed 400 and 409 message text
source: Template and Rules v1 sections R5.5, R7.2 (s12) and R9; Recovery Workbench TSD S8 Deviation handling v2 T3.1, T3.2, T4, T5.3 and appendix T-A.1 and T-A.2; Recovery Workbench FSD S8 Deviation handling v3 A2.14.3.1; Recovery Workbench Event and Messaging Design v4 (EV-06 and EV-07); Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 13, 19 and 42; the metadata rows of RWB-S8-E7005-CON (Depends on (build) None; Contract, Integration and External dependencies None)
section: CON s2 Business rationale; s3 Preconditions; s7 AC3, AC4, AC5 and AC6; s9 State transitions; s11 Data; s12.2 REST operations consumed; s13 Solution plan; s17 Guardrails; s18 Traceability
description: The contract baseline fixes every shape a source gives and carries five that none gives. (1) The index set of `deviation` beyond the primary key on `id`: TSD S8 T3.1 gives columns and no indexes, and the app story needs a lookup by `case_id` for the queue and by `id` for the patch. (2) The operation name of the case announcement and the field list of its answer: Architecture v5 slide 13 gives rwb-deviation no REST edge to any service, so the pause, the resume and the route fact travel as an announcement or an event whose name no source states, and the document declares the shape only. (3) The mapping from the three values of LOV-DEV-OUTCOME (`RETURNED`, `RE_ROUTED`, `CASE_ENDED`) to the states of the DEVIATION machine of TSD S8 T4: both vocabularies are given and no pair is. (4) The outbox behind `DeviationRaised` and `DeviationCleared`: the events are the catalogue's and the two payloads are given three fields each with no envelope schema, while DP-09 is not in this key's pattern set and RWB-PLT-TE006-CON is not in the metadata. (5) The 400 and 409 message text and message ID: appendix T-A gives the statuses 401, 403, 404, 409, 422 and 503 and no 400, and section 14 of the legacy story carries four texts, none of them the conflict or the parse failure. The baseline declares the statuses, the causes and the message-ID slots, writes the placeholder where a value is missing, and fixes no business value.
evidence: TSD S8 v2 T3.1 lists DF-CAS-036 to DF-CAS-045 with types and required flags and names no index; T-A.2 gives the errors 401, 403, 404, 409, 422 and 503 for both operations and no 400; T4 gives 22 rules over the states DEV_FLAGGED, DEV_WITH_OWNER, DEV_REROUTE, DEV_RESOLVED, DEV_REJECTED, RESUMED, ROUTE_D6 and CASE_ENDED; T3.2 gives LOV-DEV-OUTCOME as RETURNED, RE_ROUTED, CASE_ENDED with no state mapping; Event and Messaging Design v4 rows EV-06 and EV-07 name caseId, deviationCode, raisedBy and caseId, deviationCode, outcome; Architecture v5 slide 13 row S8 Deviation has no R under P3, P7, P6 or S4; the metadata row of RWB-S8-E7005-CON carries no dependency.
proposed: Publish the document with the primary key as the only index; declare the case announcement as a consumed shape with the placeholder on its operation name; name both vocabularies and fix no pair; declare the two payloads from the three fields each event carries and carry the outbox as a gap; fix the statuses, the causes and the message-ID slots of the 400 and the 409 and leave the text unnamed; let step D1 number the rows and the owners confirm the missing names.
